source_contract.triangulation: native 6 m vertices; each cell split NW-NE-SE and NW-SW-SE
source_contract.P: one nominal physical/sea surface per cell; consumer compares max(P,0.85), using 0.85 if P is NaN
source_contract.F: visible four-corner surface in [NW,NE,SW,SE] order, raw per-corner values when P is finite; consumer falls back to 0.85 when P is NaN
source_contract.crossing_equation: For current d_i=h_i-L_i and d_j=h_j-L_j with t=-d_i/(d_j-d_i), preserve the edge crossing exactly with (1-t)*delta_i+t*delta_j=0. End-point/equal-edge cases are handled explicitly.
source_contract.noncrossing: same endpoint signs encoded as linear half-spaces; these preserve wet/dry vertex topology but do not freeze the contour point or wetted area.
source_contract.fixed: patch boundary and EV79 `other_fixed`, `engineering_halo`, roads/platform and all fixed reasons other than wet_support are held at zero; wet_support is relaxed only for this feasibility test.
source_contract.bounds: EV79 total ±2m and exact lower floor formula from author.py; analysis additionally requires delta<=0 at already submerged samples. This extra no-shallower condition is not an asserted universal 0.95m rule. Class!=0/water nodes remain locked.
source_contract.area_topology: Exact crossings preserve exact local contour and area. Topology-only mode retains endpoint signs but does not impose equal contour parameter or area.

patches.ev79_bound_and_calado_method: height delta bounded by author EV79 total ±2m and exact max(P,F,0.85)+1e-4 lower floor; for already submerged samples, δ<=0 so bed may deepen but not reduce current local water clearance. Other fixed and engineering halo remain zero; patch border zero.

P.constraint_kind: exact P crossings + P sign topology

P+F.constraint_kind: exact P and F crossings + sign topology

topology-only.constraint_kind: sign topology only; crossing locations and area not fixed
